name: Falvorn Agent
description: A self-hostable web execution foundation. Inspect pages, extract content, and guide bounded browser tasks through one developer API.
note: Local runtime required for autonomous browsing. The homepage demo illustrates the workflow.

name: NEXUS-100
description: A governed orchestration layer with 10 domain orchestrators and 100 capability-scoped specialists. Make task routing, model allocation, and permissions explicit.
note: Architecture console. Public integrations do not perform external write actions.

name: AgentVerse
description: Create digital employees for research, engineering, data analysis and support. Add knowledge, assign tasks, and carry your workspace with you.
note: AI availability is subject to shared free quotas. Knowledge is stored in your browser.

name: AutoRAG Router
description: An explainable retrieval workbench that matches a question to a retrieval strategy and exposes the evidence behind the result.
note: Public lab runs actual browser-side routing over sample documents; no cloud model or hosted Python backend.

name: SparkCert
description: Inspect SSH-managed Linux systems, evaluate existing local models, and export traceable readiness reports from your workstation.
note: An independent readiness workbench, not an accredited or NVIDIA-approved certification.

name: SparkTwin
description: Explore model memory budgets, precision, context and concurrency before committing valuable GPU time to a private AI deployment.
note: Planning estimates are not measured performance or hardware deployment guarantees.

name: SparkPrivacy
description: A local-first data protection workbench with pattern detection, block/redact/monitor policies, and a gateway for private text-chat workflows.
note: Pattern detection can miss sensitive information. The interactive example is a simplified browser-side demonstration.

name: PhishGuard
description: A browser extension and companion site that explain URL and page-structure risk signals, with private on-device assessment history.
note: Heuristic assessments are not safety guarantees. False positives and negatives are possible.

name: ARES Studio
description: A local-first workspace for authorized static binary inspection, strings, optional disassembly, and local AI-assisted analysis notes.
note: Static analysis workflow preview. This website does not accept or execute binaries.

name: BatteryGuard AI
description: Explore explainable battery risk signals, incident timelines and digital-twin views for telecom and data-center operations.
note: Simulated advisory demo. Not a certified battery-management or emergency-protection system.

name: PiKey AI
description: A hardware-authenticated local AI concept using a Raspberry Pi USB key, cryptographic identity verification and a locally running model.
note: Interactive hardware workflow illustration. A compatible physical device and local software are required.

name: Chotpot
description: A Bangladesh-focused marketplace bringing food, retail, appointments and education into one multi-role application.
note: Pilot experience. Payment and operational availability depend on the application configuration.

name: Multi-Agent Intelligence
description: An orchestration foundation for specialized agents, explicit tool permissions, scheduled tasks, persistent events and human-controlled automation.
note: The public demo visualizes architecture; the executable backend is separately hosted or run locally.

name: CBDs Business Suite
description: A Windows business workspace for product sourcing, inventory, shipment costing, partner expenses and profitability management.
note: Product overview. Desktop access is available by arrangement.

name: Spark Recovery
description: An independent Ethernet recovery toolkit for selected DGX Spark OEM systems, with explicit preparation, verification and recovery consent steps.
note: Independent utility. Hardware qualification varies by model; recovery is never performed from this website.
